Capacity loss In this section, the DV method is employed to quantify lithium plating for LIBs during charging and discharging cycles. As illustrated in Fig. 9, lithium plating can be detected by analyzing the DV peaks that correspond to lithium plating and stripping processes, enabling accurate quantification of lithium deposition. Irreversible lithium plating can consume usable lithium within a battery, accelerating capacity degradation. In severe cases, it may cause internal short circuits as lithium dendrites grow and potentially pierce the battery separator, posing safety risks.
